meta.derivedFrom: src/Router.jsx, src/App.jsx, src/pages/*, src/data/pages-content.json; cross-checked against the crawl in .recon/pages/

categories.SHELL: Site chrome present on every designed page: fixed nav, footer, footer overlays.
categories.HERO: First block under the nav that names the page; each variant has its own load intro.
categories.WORK: Project showcase blocks: work cards, case-study media and copy.
categories.LIST: Hairline-ruled row lists (services, awards, mentions, team, products, pricing).
categories.PROOF: Social proof: client/partner logos and testimonials.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial blocks: statements, process copy, FAQ, blog cards, article body.
categories.CTA: Blocks whose job is to get the visitor to make contact.
categories.SYSTEM: Host-level pages outside the site's design system.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 44px nav: two-line wordmark, LABS/PROJECTS/INDEX/NEWS links, underlined CONTACT link with arrow; collapses to a slide-down menu at ≤991. Marks the current route's link #120DF7.

shell.footer.description: Four footer blocks (brand + certified-partner badge, address, products, sitemap/socials) with char-split reveal; includes the partner-credits trigger.

shell.partner-credits.description: Hidden full-screen overlay opened from the footer: white cover scales in, then a 4-column list of partner credit rows with logos and diagonal arrows.
shell.partner-credits.scope: Every template except the 404, mounted inside the footer.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: three-word display h1 with random char fade, subhead, info block (address/email/phone), 'Things we did' button, plus two hero work cards; runs the full ~2.9s load intro.

hero.words.description: Words-only display hero: the h1 words spread across the 6-column grid, no subhead or cards; intro widens the heading (92/65/60%→100%) and shrinks the header from 90vh.
hero.words.scope: About, Work, Contact and Blog list templates.

hero.services.description: Services hero: 'our' in column 1, 'services' in columns 3–4 sliding in from x −50%, and an intro paragraph rising word by word.

hero.blog-post.description: Article header in the 688px column: 4:3 hero image, 40px h1, subtitle, date and author (empty values hidden).

hero.case-study.description: Case-study header: h1, project brief, scope list, credits and live-link buttons.

work.home-grid.description: Homepage selected-work grid: 10 work cards placed on a 6-column grid with negative offsets, year labels, diagonal-arrow detail rows, and a 'see all' button.

work.full-grid.description: Full project index: 25 work cards in 4 grid wrappers, same card component as the homepage grid, no 'see all' button.

work.case-subhead.description: Stack overview with numbered items beside a square image (Lottie on Cheggout).

work.case-full-width.description: Full-width showcase media: image, GIF, Lottie, or the YouTube embed (56.17% box) on Watch with Papa.
work.case-full-width.scope: Case study template; appears 1–2 times per study.

work.case-image-text.description: Alternating image/text showcase row with highlights list.
work.case-image-text.scope: Case study template; repeats 2–4 times per study.

work.case-two-images.description: Two showcase images side by side.
work.case-two-images.scope: Case study template; Cheggout only in the current data.

work.case-view-project.description: Closing wide 'see more work' ButtonV2 (links to /about, as on the original).

content.home-about.description: Homepage about statement and long paragraph with a button.

content.about-intro.description: About page intro paragraph in columns 4–6, word-split rise on load.

content.process.description: 'Our process' heading and copy in columns 5–6.

content.faq.description: Five-item accordion; items open independently, height 0↔auto and plus icon scaleY over 0.5s.

content.blog-cards.description: Staggered blog card grid with image-scale reveal and arrow-swap hover; 3 cards on Home/About, all 10 on the blog list.

content.blog-body.description: Rich-text article body rendered from structured blocks (p/h2/h3/h4/ol/figure), PP Mori Semibold for bold.

content.more-blogs.description: 'Read more' row of 2 BlogCards at the end of an article.

list.services.description: Homepage services: 4 rows that widen 20→100% on reveal, plus a 46%-wide button.

list.awards.description: 4 award groups (11 rows) with award logo scale-in, winner name and label; rows turn accent on hover.

list.media-mentions.description: 4 media-mention rows with diagonal arrows; border to accent on hover.

list.team.description: 12 team rows; hovering shows a grayscale 229px portrait at column 4 and turns the border black.

list.products.description: 3 product rows with double up-right arrows (second delayed 200ms) and accent border on hover.

list.pricing.description: Services pricing table: 5-column grid, 4 rows rising from 200px on load; no row interactions.

proof.partners.description: Partner/client logo tiles in rows of 5 with deliberate empty columns, random-stagger scale-in; 15 tiles + button on Home, 21 tiles in 4 rows and no button on About ('Clients').

proof.testimonials.description: 6-slide testimonial slider, 'outin' crossfade, PREV/NEXT text arrows, loops, no autoplay.

cta.contact-lines.description: Three huge masked display lines that slide in alternately, plus a 192px contact button.

cta.contact-info.description: Contact page info row: phone, email and address.

cta.contact-form.description: Enquiry form: name, email, required 5-option budget select, project description, submit; native validation, #FFDEDE error box. Local stub — does not post to Webflow.

system.not-found.description: Webflow's hosting-level 'Page not found' on #f5f5f5, no site chrome; system fonts stand in for Graphik/Roboto Mono.

templates.name: Case study
templates.notes: Showcase section order is data-driven per study (src/data/pages-content.json caseStudies[*].sections); listed here in first-appearance order.
Catch-all for unmatched paths; not a real route, so it adds 0 to totalRoutes.
